neighbours.label: the token 'portal' (a web portal or a gateway/doorway portal)
fire: Students can check their grades through the university portal every Friday.
In the final scene a glowing portal opens above the ruined city.
The government launched a new tax portal for small businesses.
Log in to the patient portal to see your test results.
The wizard stepped through the portal and vanished.
Our company intranet portal was down for most of Monday.
Job seekers flooded the recruitment portal after the announcement.
Legends say an ancient portal lies hidden beneath the mountain.

Log in to the patient app to see your test results.
The wizard stepped through the archway and vanished.

notes: Card: 'portal'/' portal'/' Portal' are the most frequent peak tokens; other peaks (Affairs, supercut) look like stragglers.
